snippet.title: Job Fit For a Devil - a new game announcement!
snippet.description:
Add this game to your wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3969610/Job_Fit_For_a_Devil

Job Fit For a Devil - an adventure game with crafting and transformations about a devil in the service of Peter the Great. Play as a little imp - trick, lie, steal and cheat in order to get your way and move up the ladder!

Telegram: https://t.me/Baba_Yaga_Games
X: https://x.com/BabaYaga_Games
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@babayaga__games
